plan:
Aggregate
  ->  Nested Loop
        ->  Seq Scan on probe p
        ->  Index Scan using fp_reg_idx on fp f
              Index Cond: (reg @> p.pos)

Aggregate
  ->  Hash Join
        Hash Cond: (fc.fid = f.fid)
        Join Filter: skycell_in_cone(p.ra, p."dec", f.ra0, f.dec0, f.r, '-1'::double precision)
        ->  Nested Loop
              ->  Seq Scan on probe p
              ->  Index Scan using fp_cells_idx on fp_cells fc
                    Index Cond: (nuniq = ANY (skycell_ancestors(p.cell, 5, 11)))
        ->  Hash
              ->  Seq Scan on fp f
